package probe

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
	"unsafe"
)

// A grouped import that holds both reaches a command's fields both ways, and
// each import is a finding of its own: one finding per line, the import a
// reader removes (P6).

func reflectUnsafeEnv(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	cmd.Env = []string{}
	reflect.ValueOf(cmd).Elem().FieldByName("Env").Set(reflect.ValueOf([]string{}))
	_ = unsafe.Pointer(cmd)
}
